embedding.instruction: Represent this coding-agent state for retrieval of prior states requiring similar reasoning capability and model strength.

split.selection_rule: Exclude every trajectory touched by the prior OOB campaign, then sample 8 holdout trajectories by Python random.Random(seed); all remaining trajectories are calibration training data.

evaluation_design.primary: Five-fold trajectory-grouped nested evaluation; KNN hyperparameters are selected only inside each outer training fold.
evaluation_design.policy: q90 selects the smallest tier covering 90% predicted required-tier probability.
evaluation_design.label_scope: Required-tier labels for the fixed TwinRouterBench four-model pool; not transferable capability labels for arbitrary future models.
